header_context.D2: AACN Essentials  Domain 1: Knowledge for Nursing Practice
header_context.D3: Descriptor: Integration, translation, and application of established and evolving disciplinary nursing knowledge and ways of knowing, as well as knowledge from other disciplines, including a foundation in liberal arts and natural and social sciences. This distinguishes the practice of professional nursing and forms the basis for clinical judgment and innovation in nursing practice.
header_context.E4: 1.2 Apply theory and research-based knowledge from nursing, the arts, humanities, and other sciences.
header_context.F4: 1.3 Demonstrate clinical judgment founded on a broad knowledge base.
